item.title: [Episode 35] Washington's Noise, Beijing's Telegram ([35화] 워싱턴의 소음, 베이징의 전문)
item.description:
[Episode 35] Washington's Noise, Beijing's Telegram ([35화] 워싱턴의 소음, 베이징의 전문)

☞ View from Episode 1 (☞ 1화부터 보기)

☞ Character Introduction (☞ 등장인물 소개)

Unlike South Korea, where the primary enemy is clear-cut, the Japan business involved geopolitical factors so intricately entangled that it was practically impossible for a working-level official like Evan to set the stage. (주적(主敵)이 명확한 한국과 달리, 일본 사업은 지정학 요소가 한층 더 복잡하게 얽혀 있는 탓에, 에반과 같은 실무급이 판을 짜는 것은 사실상 불가능했다.)

The fury Patrick unleashed in the Arlington conference room was nothing more than theater for effect. (패트릭이 알링턴 회의실에서 뿜은 분노는 연기를 위한 연기였을 뿐.)

In a world where people even consider which country a car comes from before buying it, defense contracts and foreign policy are inevitably a high-dimensional equation, moving in lockstep like a three-legged race. (하물며 자동차 한 대를 살 때도 어느 나라 차인지를 따지는 판에, 방산 계약과 외교 정책은 늘 이인삼각 경기처럼 맞물려 갈 수밖에 없는 고차원 방정식이다.)

In truth, the Dudael executives knew this better than anyone. Untying the Gordian Knot ultimately came down to horse-trading between heads of state. (사실 그건 듀다엘 경영진이 누구보다 잘 알았다. 고르디우스의 매듭을 푸는 것은, 결국 국가 정상 간의 맞교환이라는 것을.)

Alistair, the chairman of Dudael Tech, had decided to serve faithfully as an unofficial messenger on behalf of the government on this complex chessboard. What he demanded from Washington in return was anyone's guess. (듀다엘 테크의 의장인 앨리스터는 이 복잡한 체스판에서, 정부를 대신해 비공식 메신저 역할에 충실하기로 했다. 그 대가로 워싱턴에 무엇을 요구했는지는 알 길이 없지만.)

Alistair used his mansion in McLean, Virginia, as a venue to relay unofficial government messages, much like a presidential retreat. (앨리스터는 버지니아주 맥클린 저택을 대통령 별장처럼 정부의 비공식 메시지를 전달하는 장소로 썼다.)

Of course, someone of Alistair's standing could have established himself in Florida, the Hamptons, or Nantucket, but he believed the safest place on Earth was McLean, five minutes from Langley. (물론, 앨리스터 정도의 위치라면 플로리다에도, 햄프턴스에도, 낸터킷에 자리 잡을 수도 있었겠지만, 지구상에서 가장 안전한 곳은 랭리에서 5분 거리인 이곳 맥클린이라고 그는 믿었다.)

A place where Washington's political noise, crossing the Potomac River, was swallowed up and extinguished by the woods. Alistair was savoring the lush greenery of late summer outside his second-floor study in the grand forest estate when the doorbell rang, and he slowly turned around. (워싱턴의 정치적 소음이 포토맥강을 건너오다 숲에 가로막혀 소멸하는 곳. 앨리스터는 울창한 숲속 대저택의 2층 서재에서 창밖의 늦여름의 푸릇함을 만끽하다가, 초인종이 울리자 천천히 몸을 돌렸다.)

"Welcome, Minister Chen. Thank you for making the trip all the way to McLean." (“어서 오십시오, 천 공사님. 맥클린까지 오시느라 고생하셨습니다.”)

Chen Wei, the Commercial Counselor at the Chinese Embassy in Washington, had rushed over at Alistair's invitation from a few days earlier. He seemed to have expected some good news. He was a veteran diplomat from the Communist Youth League, an unofficial party messenger who moved deftly between the hawkish faction toward the U.S. and the pragmatic line. (주미 중국 대사관 상무공사 천웨이는 며칠 전 앨리스터의 초청을 받고 한걸음에 달려왔다. 무언가 희소식을 기대한 모양이었다. 그는 공청단 출신 베테랑 외교관으로, 대미 강경파와 실용주의 노선 사이를 능숙하게 오가는 당의 비공식 메신저였다.)

Counselor Chen, wearing a tailored suit, a blue tie, and a smile that would suit any lobbyist on K Street, gave Alistair a slight nod. (천 공사는 맞춤 수트, 파란 넥타이, 그리고 K 스트리트의 어느 로비스트에게나 어울릴 법한 미소를 입고, 앨리스터에게 가볍게 목례했다.)

It was a greeting honed over ten years on American soil. (미국 땅에서 10년을 갈고닦은 인사법이었다.)

"Thank you for the invitation. As the rumors say, this place is a fortress." (“초대해 주셔서 감사합니다. 소문대로 요새 같은 곳이군요.”)

"Apologies if it felt uncomfortable. As you know, these days there are far too many uninvited guests roaming about." (“불편하셨다면 사과드립니다. 아시다시피, 요즘 세상엔 너무 많은 초대받지 않은 손님들이 돌아다니니까요.”)

Alistair smiled warmly and led Chen Wei toward the window. (앨리스터는 사람 좋은 미소를 지으며 천웨이를 창가로 안내했다.)

"Many people keep estates in Palm Beach or Malibu, but I love McLean the most. There's no place on Earth where security is as guaranteed as here." (“많은 사람이 팜비치나 말리부에 별장을 두곤 하지만, 저는 맥클린을 가장 사랑합니다. 지구상에서 여기만큼 안전이 보장된 곳은 없으니까요.”)

Chen Wei glanced up at the sky outside and fired off a barbed joke. (천웨이는 창밖의 하늘을 올려다보며 뼈 있는 농담을 던졌다.)

"Indeed... at least there's no chance of another plane flying into this sky." (“확실히…… 적어도 이 하늘에 다시 비행기가 날아와 꽂히는 일은 없겠군요.”)

At the 9/11 joke, the kind a British comedian might crack, Alistair let out a hearty laugh like an audience member dragged along unwillingly. (영국 코미디언이나 던질 법한 9·11 농담에, 앨리스터는 억지로 끌려온 관객처럼 너털웃음을 지었다.)

"You've been in America so long you've picked up Western humor. But this is no laughing matter. Do you know something? Even the faint warmth of this teacup we're holding might be read by satellites beyond the atmosphere." (“미국에 오래 계시더니 서구 유머까지 갖추셨군요. 허나 농담으로만 넘길 일은 아닙니다. 혹시 아십니까? 지금 우리가 든 이 찻잔의 미세한 열기마저, 저 대기권 밖의 위성이 읽어내고 있을지.”)

He raised his gaze as if piercing through the ceiling into the sky. (천장 너머 하늘을 꿰뚫어 보듯 시선을 올렸다.)

"If you knew how dense and thick the layer of surveillance covering the skies above McLean is... you'd understand what I mean." (“이 맥클린의 상공을 덮고 있는 감시의 레이어가 얼마나 촘촘하고 두터운지 아신다면…… 제 말이 무슨 뜻인지 이해하실 겁니다.”)

Alistair leisurely transferred tea leaves into the strainer with a wooden spoon. (앨리스터는 여유롭게 찻잎을 나무 수저로 거름망에 옮겼다.)

"How is the taste? Most Westerners divide tea into black-and-white logic. Unfermented green tea, or fully oxidized black tea. They're only used to the extremes." (“맛이 어떻습니까? 보통 서양인들은 차를 흑백 논리로 나누죠. 발효시키지 않은 녹차, 아니면 완전히 산화시킨 홍차. 양극단에만 익숙해져 있습니다.”)

The secretary poured warm water, and for thirty seconds, the two silently watched the aroma of the first infusion spread through the study. (비서가 따뜻한 물을 붓고, 30초 동안 두 사람은 아무 말 없이 첫 번째 우림의 향이 서재에 퍼지는 것을 지켜봤다.)

"But what captured my palate is something that lingers in between. A semi-fermented tea that holds both the freshness of green tea and the depth of black tea. Most call it oolong, but I prefer that subtle nuance of 'qing cha' — blue-green tea." (“허나 제 입맛을 사로잡은 건 그 경계에 머물러 있는 녀석입니다. 녹차의 신선함과 홍차의 깊이를 동시에 품은 반발효차. 흔히 우롱차라 부르지만, 저는 청차(靑茶)라는 그 오묘한 어감을 더 아낍니다.”)

Alistair handed over a teacup. (앨리스터가 찻잔을 건넸다.)

"A flavor of exquisite moderation, not fully green as its name suggests. Doesn't it resemble the aesthetics of diplomacy, which must strike a balance between black and white?" (“이름만큼 완전히 푸르지도 않은 절묘한 중용의 맛. 흑과 백 사이에서 균형을 잡아야 하는 외교의 미학과도 닮아 있지 않습니까?”)

With deft hands, he poured hot water and steeped the leaves. A soft yet weighty orchid fragrance filled the study. (그는 능숙한 손놀림으로 뜨거운 물을 붓고 찻잎을 우려냈다. 은은하면서도 묵직한 난초 향이 서재를 채웠다.)

"This is Fenghuang Dancong Song Zhong. Leaves picked from thousand-year-old tea trees on Fenghuang Mountain in Guangdong Province." (“봉화단총 송종(宋種)입니다. 광둥성 봉황산의 천년 된 고차수에서 딴 잎이죠.”)

He slid the teacup toward Chen Wei. (찻잔을 천웨이 앞으로 밀었다.)

"Do you know why this tea is called Song Zhong? Because it descends from a varietal cherished by the Song Dynasty emperors. I have a great fondness for the Song Dynasty in Chinese history." (“이 차의 이름이 왜 송종인지 아십니까? 송나라 황제들이 아꼈던 품종의 후예이기 때문입니다. 저는 중국 역사에서 송나라를 참 좋아합니다.”)

Chen Wei lifted the warm cup and savored the subtle aroma of the qing cha. But his eyes turned cold. (천웨이는 따뜻한 찻잔을 들어 청차의 은은한 향을 음미했다. 하지만 눈빛은 차갑게 가라앉았다.)

"Instead of wasting national strength on reckless wars, the wisdom of buying peace with money might be today's lesson. Thanks to that, culture flourished, and even a thousand years later, we can still drink this tea, can't we." (“무리한 전쟁으로 국력을 낭비하는 대신, 평화를 돈으로 사는 지혜가 오늘날 교훈이 아닐까 싶습니다. 덕분에 문화가 꽃피었고, 천년이 지난 지금도 우리가 이 차를 마실 수 있게 되지 않았습니까.”)

"The fragrance is exquisite. But Alistair, you've overlooked one thing." (“향이 일품이군요. 하지만 앨리스터, 하나 간과하신 게 있습니다.”)

He set down the cup and retorted toward Alistair. (찻잔을 내려놓으며 앨리스터를 향해 대꾸했다.)

"The figure the Chinese admire most in Song Dynasty history is not an emperor. It's General Yue Fei." (“중국인들이 송나라 역사에서 가장 존경하는 인물은 황제가 아닙니다. 악비(岳飛) 장군이죠.”)

"Yue Fei... You mean the tragic general." (“악비라…… 비운의 장군 말씀입니까.")

"A hero who chose death over kneeling to the barbarians and fought to the end. We call that spirit the soul of China." (“오랑캐에게 무릎 꿇느니 죽음을 택하겠다며 끝까지 싸운 영웅입니다. 우리는 그 기개를 중화의 혼이라 부르죠.”)

Chen Wei paused for a beat and continued. (천웨이가 한 박자 쉬고 말을 이어갔다.)

"Peace is not bought with money; it's defended with blood." (“평화는 돈으로 사는 게 아니라, 피로 지키는 법입니다.”)

It was small talk empty of a single lie. Chen Wei had chilled the cordial atmosphere in an instant. (한 방울의 거짓도 담지 않은 한담이었다. 천웨이는 이 화기애애한 분위기를 순식간에 식혀 버렸다.)

As Alistair set down his cup, the temperature in the room dropped with it. (앨리스터가 찻잔을 내려놓자, 방 안의 온도가 함께 내려갔다.)

"Yue Fei's spirit is admirable, but reality is harsh. Let me get to the point." (“악비의 기개는 훌륭하지만, 현실은 냉혹하죠. 본론을 말씀드리겠습니다.”)

"We are finalizing a plan to elevate Japan's Shirakawa Heavy Industries beyond simple maintenance for the U.S. Seventh Fleet, into a strategic logistics base and new shipbuilding partner for the U.S. Navy. I'm also informing you in advance that the Sariel system will be fitted on those warships." (“미 7함대의 단순 정비를 넘어, 일본 시라카와 중공업을 미 해군의 전략적 병참 기지이자 신조함 건조 파트너로 격상하는 방안을 최종 조율 중입니다. 그 군함들에 사리엘을 장착하게 되는 점도 미리 말씀드립니다.”)

Chen Wei's expression hardened. The Sariel introduction was expected, but shipbuilding and logistics basing were a different matter entirely. (천웨이의 표정이 딱딱하게 굳었다. 사리엘 도입은 예상했지만, 함정 건조와 병참 기지화는 차원이 다른 문제였다.)

"That... is crossing a river with no return, Alistair." (“그건…… 돌아올 수 없는 강을 건너는 겁니다, 앨리스터.”)

His voice trembled low. (목소리가 낮게 떨렸다.)

"This is an act that shatters the balance of East Asia. Do you think Beijing will sit idly by? I no longer have any grounds to persuade the hawks back home." (“동아시아의 균형을 무너뜨리는 행위입니다. 베이징이 가만히 있을 거라 생각합니까? 나도 본국의 강경파들을 더는 설득할 명분이 없습니다.”)

"That's exactly why I invited you today." (“그래서 오늘 모신 겁니다.”)

Alistair leisurely lifted the teapot and refilled his own cup. (앨리스터는 여유롭게 찻주전자를 들어 자신의 잔을 채웠다.)

"Rather than being caught off guard reading this story on the front page of the Wall Street Journal, wouldn't it look better for the capable Counselor Chen to cable it directly to your home country as a diplomatic telegram? This is a courtesy from me." (“월스트리트저널 1면에서 이 기사를 접하고 당황하시는 것보다는, 유능하신 천 공사님이 본국에 직접 외교 전문으로 타전하는 게 모양새가 좋지 않겠습니까? 이건 제가 드리는 배려입니다.”)

"A courtesy." (“배려라.”)

Chen Wei echoed. His lips pressed tightly together. This wasn't a negotiation. It was a notification. (천웨이가 되뇌었다. 입술이 지그시 깨물렸다. 이것은 협상이 아니었다. 통보였다.)

"...This tea tastes rather bitter after all." (“……이 차 맛은 생각보다 꽤 쓰군요.")

Chen Wei set down his unfinished cup and rose from his seat. (천웨이는 다 마시지 못한 찻잔을 내려놓고 자리에서 일어났다.)

item.title: Park Beom-kye "Jung Cheong-rae, Claim That Myeong-Cheong Battle Is Fiction? That Statement Is Fiction... It Originated Because of Jung" (박범계 “정청래, 명청대전이 허구? 그 말이 허구...鄭 탓에 생긴 말” )
item.description:
<<>> Democratic Party lawmaker Park Beom-kye responded to party leadership candidate Jung Cheong-rae's recent remark that the so-called 'Myeong-Cheong conflict' is "a fiction that does not exist," saying, "The Myeong-Cheong battle was a natural term coined by pro-Myeong supporters who back the president" and "that statement (Jung's claim that the Myeong-Cheong battle does not exist) is the fiction." ()

Park, who is backing candidate Kim Min-seok, said on CBS Radio's 'Park Jae-hong's One-on-One Show' on the night of the 4th, "The term Myeong-Cheong battle was not coined by candidate Kim Min-seok. It was a natural term created by many so-called pro-Myeong supporters who support President (Lee Jae-myung)." Park added, "Until before the June 13 local elections, President Lee Jae-myung's authority over so-called state affairs momentum was immense. But after the local election results came out, the opposition's voice grew louder. They began nitpicking and criticizing President Lee Jae-myung on every issue." He then said, "The person who commanded that election was (candidate Jung)" and "The local election results ultimately became the catalyst for the president's governing momentum and authority to be questioned and criticized." (박범계 더불어민주당 의원은 정청래 당 대표 후보가 최근 이른바 ‘명청 갈등’을 두고 “존재하지 않는 허구”라고 한 데 대해 “명청대전은 대통령을 지지하는, 친명 지지자들이 만들어낸 자연스러운 용어였다”며 “그 말(명청 대전이 없다는 정 후보 발언)이 허구”라고 했다.)

Park said, "Candidate Kim spent 18 years (away from the party) as a political outsider, not even an unemployed person but a retired political figure, enduring difficult times" and "Using a person's extremely hard period as a target of criticism is a truly heartless attitude." (김민석 후보를 지지하고 있는 박 의원은 4일 밤 CBS라디오 ‘박재홍의 한판 승부’에서 “명청대전이라는 거는 김민석 후보가 만들어낸 용어가 아니다. (이재명) 대통령을 지지하는 많은 소위 친명 지지자들이 만들어낸 자연스러운 용어였다”고 했다. 박 의원은 “6·13 지방선거가 있기 전까지 이재명 대통령의 소위 국정 동력에 대한 권위가 굉장했다.그런데 지방선거 결과가 나온 이후로 야당의 목소리가 커졌습니다. 사사건건 트집을 잡아서 이재명 대통령을 비난하기 시작했다”라고 했다. 그러면서 “그 선거를 지휘한 사람이 (정 후보)”라며 “대통령의 국정 운영의 동력과 권위가 결국은 의심받고 비판받는 계기가 지방 선거 결과였다”고 했다.)

Recently, candidate Jung criticized Kim for leaving the Democratic Party in 2002 to join Chung Mong-joon's camp after advocating for a Roh Moo-hyun-Chung Mong-joon candidate unification ahead of that year's presidential election, saying, "There is no limit to betrayal" and "Someone who betrayed once will betray again." (박 의원은 “김 후보는 (당을 떠난) 18년 동안 말 그대로 백수도 아닌 퇴수, 정치적 야인으로 어려운 시절을 보냈다”며 “한 인간으로서 굉장히 어려웠던 시절을 비난의 대상으로 삼는 건 참으로 몰인정한 태도”라고 했다.)

In response, Park said, "In 2008, President Roh Moo-hyun also wrote in his autobiography that 'we have officially reconciled historically.'" He continued, "Does candidate Jung really have the qualification to make such an assessment about a person's life?" and "Using such excessive language is not acceptable." (최근 정 후보는 김 후보가 2002년 대선 당시 노무현·정몽준 후보 단일화를 주장하며 민주당을 탈당해 정몽준 캠프에 합류한 것을 두고 “배신에는 총량이 없다”며 “한 번 배신한 사람은 또 배신한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Cho Kuk Blames Blue House for 'Leverage ETF' Mess: "Kim Yong-beom Cannot Slip Away" (조국 ‘레버리지 ETF’두고 靑 책임론 “김용범 어물쩍 넘길 수 없어”)
item.description:
Cho Kuk, director of the Innovation Policy Research Institute under the Rebuilding Korea Party, said on the 5th, "Since the ruling Democratic Party is staying silent, I will speak clearly from a 'red team' perspective," arguing that "the government's introduction of single-stock leverage ETFs is a clear policy failure." He further stated, "The current situation is a 'failure of state-directed finance' created by the core policy officials led by Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom, including the Blue House policy office, the Office for Government Policy Coordination, the Financial Services Commission, and the Financial Supervisory Service," and insisted that they must be held accountable. <<> In a Facebook post that day, Director Cho said, "After Policy Chief Kim held an informal meeting with heads of securities firms and asset management companies on January 13 this year, the Financial Services Commission pushed ahead with a legislative notice on January 30," adding, "Subsequently, the enforcement decree of the Capital Markets Act was passed at a Cabinet meeting on April 21, and the products were listed on the market on May 27." <<> He continued, "There were experts who pointed out it was premature, but the Blue House policy chief insisted on the introduction and stirred up momentum, and 16 single-stock leverage ETFs hit the market right before the June 3 election. However, after the election, on June 22, Financial Supervisory Service Governor Lee Bok-hyun made remarks saying, 'I should have blocked it by lying down and refusing to budge.' One cannot help but call this policy decision process a 'mystery.'" <<> He noted, "In particular, looking at the press release distributed by the Financial Services Commission on April 21 titled 'Cabinet Resolution of the Amendment to the Enforcement Decree of the Capital Markets Act to Resolve Asymmetric Regulation Between Domestic and Overseas-Listed ETFs,' it appears there was no sufficient discussion of policy side effects at that Cabinet meeting," adding, "In the publicly disclosed minutes, the Prime Minister presided due to the President's overseas trip, and under 'discussion' regarding the resolution of the enforcement decree, it was recorded as 'no objections.'" <<> He then said, "One cannot help but wonder why the government carelessly and hastily rushed the 'money move' from real estate to the stock market," and "62% of the accounts forcibly liquidated belonged to young people aged 35 and under. The young people who invested trusting the government's resolve have fallen into the leverage trap laid by the government, ending up with lifelong trauma and debt that can never be erased." <<> He asked, "Will the government just tell them, 'We provided warnings about the risks'?" adding, "On the other hand, a small number of forces who reaped enormous speculative profits by riding the extreme volatility have been observed triggering a 'reverse money move,' pouring the massive liquidity swept up from the stock market back into the real estate market." <<> Director Cho said, "Policy Chief Kim, along with Office for Government Policy Coordination Chief Yoon Chang-ryeol, Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Bok-hyun, and FSS Governor Lee Bok-hyun, must each be held accountable," and "The entire process from start to finish—including the incomprehensible 'mysterious' introduction process, the belated response that worsened the damage, and the ineffective patchwork measures—must be fully revealed, and those responsible must take responsibility." He also stated, "The government must return to the 'original intent' of its goal of a 'KOSPI 5,000 era.' In particular, it must resolve the lives of young people who entered the leverage trap in an attempt to escape the quagmire of extreme inequality," adding, "The government should not be one that encourages young people to invest in stocks, but one that invests in young people." (조국 조국혁신당 혁신정책연구원장은 5일 “집권 민주당이 침묵하고 있기에 ‘레드팀’ 입장에서 분명히 말한다”며 “정부의 단일종목 레버리지ETF도입은 명백한 정책 실패”라고 주장했다. 그러면서 “작금의 사태는 청와대 정책실, 국무조정실, 금융위원회, 금융감독원 등 김용범 정책실장을 필두로 한 정부의 정책 핵심들이 만들어낸 ‘관치 금융의 실패”라며 이들에 대한 책임을 물어야 한다고 했다.)

item.title: Ambassador Steel Meets Cho Hyun, Likely Discussed Coupang and U.S. Investment (조현 만난 스틸 대사, 쿠팡·대미투자 논의한 듯)
item.description:
Ambassador Steel Meets Cho Hyun, Likely Discussed Coupang and U.S. Investment (조현 만난 스틸 대사, 쿠팡·대미투자 논의한 듯)

U.S. Ambassador to South Korea Michelle Steel began her official duties on the 4th by submitting a copy of her credentials to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. This came just five days after her arrival on the 30th of last month. That afternoon, accompanied by her husband, attorney Sean Steel, Ambassador Steel arrived at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs building in Jongno-gu, Seoul, submitted a copy of her credentials to Chief of Protocol Kang Sang-wook, and then paid a courtesy call on Foreign Minister Cho Hyun. (미셸 스틸 주한 미국 대사가 4일 외교부에 신임장 사본을 제출하며 공식 활동을 시작했다. 지난달 30일 부임한 지 닷새 만이다. 이날 오후 남편 숀 스틸 변호사와 함께 서울 종로구 외교부 청사에 도착한 스틸 대사는 강상욱 의전장에게 신임장 사본을 제출한 직후, 조현 외교부 장관도 예방했다.)

Newly appointed foreign ambassadors are required to go through the credentialing ceremony, in which they present the letters of credence issued by their home country's head of state to the head of the host country. However, submitting a copy of the credentials to the Foreign Ministry's chief of protocol before presenting them to the president allows the ambassador to begin substantive diplomatic activities, such as official meetings with host government officials or contact with other foreign ambassadors. (새로 부임하는 외국 대사는 파견국의 국가 원수가 수여한 신임장을 주재국 원수에게 전달하는 제정식을 해야 한다. 다만 대통령에게 신임장을 제정하기 전에 외교부 의전장에게 신임장 사본을 제출하면 주재국 정부 당국자들과의 공식 면담이나 타국 대사들과의 접촉 등 실질적인 외교 활동을 개시할 수 있다.)

Foreign Ministry spokesperson Park Du-sun said at a briefing, "This visit to the minister was for the purpose of a courtesy call upon arrival, and both sides also exchanged views on ways to advance the South Korea-U.S. relationship." Minister Cho and Ambassador Steel are believed to have discussed key issues between the two countries, including U.S. investment in Korea and the Coupang matter. During her U.S. Senate confirmation hearing in May, Ambassador Steel addressed the Coupang issue, stating, "Just as Korean companies receive equal treatment in the United States, American companies should enjoy the same market access in Korea," and adding, "Once I take office, I will make sure to follow up on this issue." (박두순 외교부 대변인은 브리핑에서 “이번 장관 예방은 부임 인사를 위한 것으로 양측은 한미 관계 발전 방안에 대해서도 의견을 교환했다”고 말했다. 조 장관과 스틸 대사는 한미 간 주요 현안인 대미 투자와 쿠팡 문제 등을 논의한 것으로 보인다. 스틸 대사는 지난 5월 미 상원 인준 청문회에서 쿠팡 문제 등과 관련해 “한국 기업이 미국에서 동등한 대우를 받고 있듯 미국 기업도 한국에서 동일한 시장 접근권을 누려야 한다”며 “부임하면 이 문제를 확실히 챙기겠다”고 했다.)

With Ambassador Steel having begun her official activities, attention is now on whether the South Korea-U.S. security consultations will gain momentum. The security talks between the two countries on introducing nuclear-powered submarines for South Korea, as well as securing permission for uranium enrichment and reprocessing of spent nuclear fuel, have not scheduled a follow-up meeting since the first session was held in June. Ambassador Steel did not respond to reporters' questions about what she discussed with Minister Cho that day. (스틸 대사가 공식 활동에 나선 만큼 한미 안보 협의에도 속도가 붙을지 주목된다. 한국의 원자력 추진 잠수함 도입과 우라늄 농축, 사용후핵연료 재처리 권한 확보를 위한 한미 간의 안보 협의는 지난 6월 1차 회의 이후 후속 일정을 잡지 못하고 있다. 스틸 대사는 이날 조 장관과 어떤 논의를 했느냐는 취재진 질문에 답하지 않았다.)

The fact that her husband, attorney Sean Steel, has accompanied her at every public event since Ambassador Steel's arrival in the country on the 30th of last month is also drawing attention. It is somewhat unusual for a sitting ambassador to be accompanied by a spouse when submitting credentials copies to the Foreign Ministry, as opposed to the official ceremony of presenting the original credentials to the president. A Foreign Ministry official said, "It's a bit of a special case, but Mr. Steel is a prominent political figure who served as chairman of the California Republican Party and is known to have extensive networks both inside and outside the Trump administration," expressing expectations that this could help build a friendly South Korea-U.S. relationship. (남편 숀 스틸 변호사가 지난달 30일 스틸 대사의 입국 직후부터 모든 공개 일정에 동행하고 있는 점도 화제를 낳고 있다. 주한 대사가 대통령에게 신임장 정본을 제정하는 공식 행사가 아닌, 외교부 사본 제출 때 배우자와 동행하는 것은 다소 이례적인 일이다. 외교부 당국자는 “조금 특별한 케이스지만, 스틸 변호사는 캘리포니아주 공화당 의장을 지낸 유력 정치인으로 트럼프 행정부 안팎에 폭넓은 네트워크를 가진 것으로 안다”며 우호적 한미 관계 구축에 도움이 될 것으로 전망했다.)

item.title: Following Machine Guns and Grenade Launchers... 1st Corps Also Keeps K2 Rifles on 'Empty-Chamber Alert' (기관총·유탄발사기 이어… 1군단, K2 소총도 ‘빈총 경계’)
item.description:
Following Machine Guns and Grenade Launchers... 1st Corps Also Keeps K2 Rifles on 'Empty-Chamber Alert' (기관총·유탄발사기 이어… 1군단, K2 소총도 ‘빈총 경계’)

The Army's 1st Corps, responsible for front-line surveillance on the western front, has been conducting guard operations at forward observation posts (GPs) and general outposts (GOPs) without loading live ammunition into personal weapons such as the K2C1 rifle for the past several years, it was confirmed on the 4th. Even before Corps Commander Han Ki-sung, who was removed from duty on the 3rd, changed the guard duty guidelines earlier this year to prohibit loading live ammunition into crew-served weapons such as the K6 heavy machine gun and K4 high-velocity grenade launcher, personal weapons were already being carried without live ammunition. <<> The Army Ground Operations Command (hereinafter referred to as GOC), which commands the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 5th Corps, recently responded to a related inquiry from Rep. Kang Sun-young of the People Power Party by stating, "Under guard duty guidelines, loading live ammunition into personal weapons is the principle," while also noting, "The 1st Corps carried the ammunition." This means the 1st Corps conducted duty with empty rifles, without loading live ammunition into personal weapons. <<> According to a compilation of this outlet's reporting, troops in the 1st Corps have, since the tenure of the previous corps commander, carried out GP and GOP guard operations without inserting magazines loaded with live ammunition into their personal weapons, instead keeping several magazines with about ten rounds each in their combat vests. A 1st Corps official claimed, "In the event of a situation, magazines in the combat vest can be quickly retrieved and attached to the rifle, so there is no operational problem," adding, "The corps' principle has always been to 'carry' the ammunition, and it was not something Commander Han changed." <<> The 1st Corps reportedly only permitted loading live ammunition during 'DMZ search and ambush operations' inside the Demilitarized Zone. It is known that the 1st Corps only began loading live ammunition into personal weapons on the 31st of last month, after the controversy over unloaded crew-served weapons came to light. Rep. Kang stated, "During GP and GOP guard operations, 'immediate action firing' is the last resort to protect the lives of our soldiers," and added, "Having them conduct guard operations with empty rifles is tantamount to leaving our soldiers defenseless in front of enemy fire." <<> The Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS), which establishes the basic framework for guard operation guidelines, claimed it was unaware of this situation in the 1st Corps. On the 31st of last month, in response to this outlet's inquiry that "there are reports that live ammunition is also not loaded into personal weapons," the JCS replied, "That is not true." Yet it has now been revealed that the 1st Corps was also not loading live ammunition into K2 rifles. On the 4th, in response to this outlet's question about when JCS Chairman Kim Myung-soo was briefed on the 'empty-chamber guard' practice for personal weapons, the JCS replied, "We cannot confirm that." A military source remarked, "The JCS said it didn't even know about the 1st Corps' unloaded crew-served weapons—so what exactly does it know?" <<> There are also arguments that the JCS is not free from responsibility for the 'empty-chamber guard' practice. In January, an Army division in Yanggu County, Gangwon Province, had personnel carry 'three-section batons' instead of firearms while on guard duty at the gate, only to retract the decision after controversy arose. At the time, the JCS had stated, "Considering the operational environment characteristics of each unit, guidelines were issued allowing general-level commanders to substitute firearms with non-lethal means such as batons or Tasers during guard operations at military bases and facilities, at their discretion." Some frontline units removing live ammunition even during guard duty to prevent safety incidents such as accidental discharges may have been influenced by such a climate. <<> At the same time, it is also pointed out as a problem that in the rear areas, cases of poorly managed firearms and ammunition are occurring one after another. On the 3rd, in Pohang, North Gyeongsang Province, a Marine Corps non-commissioned officer secretly smuggled a personal weapon and live ammunition out of the base and took his own life at an officer's quarters. The NCO had illegally removed a K1-series rifle and several rounds of live ammunition, and military authorities reportedly failed to notice the missing firearm for about 60 hours. In June of last year, at an Army unit in Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province, a trainee who had just completed basic training moved to his assigned unit in a rental car borrowed by an NCO, then got out of the car leaving the K-2 rifle inside. The unit did not realize the rifle was missing until the rental car company reported the discovery of the firearm. <<> Meanwhile, Rep. Seong Il-jong of the People Power Party claimed on the same day that the 1st Corps, which had almost mistakenly shot down a U.S. drone, again failed to immediately identify an allied drone on the 3rd. On that day, the Army Test and Evaluation Group conducted drone test evaluations in two sessions, morning and afternoon. When the drone deployed in the afternoon flew 500 feet higher than the pre-reported altitude, the 1st Corps reportedly prepared to issue a 'Duru-mi' alert, the response posture for countering enemy drones. The JCS stated, "The 1st Corps carried out normal operational procedures to comprehensively verify and assess whether the drone in question was a pre-approved drone or an unapproved one." (서부 전선 최전방 경계를 맡는 육군 1군단이 지난 수년간 K2C1 소총 등 개인화기에도 실탄을 장전하지 않고 전방 감시초소(GP)와 일반전초(GOP) 경계작전을 해온 것으로 4일 확인됐다. 지난 3일 직무배제된 한기성 군단장이 올 상반기에 공용화기인 K6 중(重)기관총과 K4 고속유탄발사기에 실탄을 장전하지 않도록 경계근무 지침을 바꾸기 전부터 개인화기에는 실탄을 넣지 않았다는 것이다.)

item.title: "Victims are in hell... this is bad politics" (“피해자들은 지옥에 있는데… 이게 나쁜 정치”)
item.description:
"Victims are in hell... this is bad politics" (“피해자들은 지옥에 있는데… 이게 나쁜 정치”)

Kim Jin-joo (pseudonym), a victim of the "Busan kick assault case," said on the 4th that after the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act abolishing prosecutors' supplementary investigative powers passed the Cabinet meeting, "Crime victims are truly in hell, yet (those at the Cabinet meeting) spoke about it as casually as if it were someone else's business." Speaking at the emergency forum held at the National Assembly that day titled "Ban on Supplementary Investigation, the Gates of Hell Have Opened," Kim said, "After watching (the Cabinet meeting), I was so angry that my hands were shaking," adding, "Bad politics is when they use victims as tools only when it benefits them." (‘부산 돌려차기 사건’의 피해자인 김진주(가명)씨가 4일 검사의 보완수사권을 폐지하는 형사소송법 개정안이 국무회의를 통과한 데 대해 “범죄 피해자들은 정말 지옥에 있는데, (국무회의 참석자들은) 남 일처럼 편안하게 얘기하시더라”고 했다. 이날 국회에서 열린 ‘보완수사 금지, 지옥문이 열렸다’ 긴급 간담회에 참석한 김씨는 “(국무회의를 보고) 화가 많이 나 손이 떨린다”면서 “나쁜 정치는 자신들이 유리할 때만 피해자를 수단으로 이용하는 것”이라고도 했다.)

In 2022, Kim was struck in the head by a man she had never met in a kick assault, losing consciousness, and was then sexually assaulted. The police initially treated the case as simple assault, but prosecutors uncovered the assailant's attempted rape-murder charges through supplementary investigation. As the Democratic Party of Korea pushed for the complete abolition of supplementary investigative powers, Kim opposed this and requested President Yoon Suk-yeol to exercise his right to request reconsideration (veto power) of the revision to the Criminal Procedure Act. (김씨는 2022년 일면식도 없는 남성에게 돌려차기로 머리를 가격당해 의식을 잃은 상태에서 성폭력 피해를 입었다. 경찰은 사건을 단순 상해로 봤지만, 검찰이 보완수사를 통해 가해자의 강간살인 미수 혐의를 밝혀냈다. 더불어민주당이 보완수사권 전면 폐지를 추진하자, 김씨는 이에 반대하며 이재명 대통령에게 형사소송법 개정안에 대한 재의요구권(거부권) 행사를 요청했었다.)

Speaking at a forum with independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon that day, Kim said, "Victims of (other crimes) send emails every day saying, 'Please help us, (the investigations) aren't being connected,'" and "It's inevitable to feel that the judicial system is on shaky ground." Kim described herself as a "lucky victim" because the prosecution's supplementary investigation made it possible to properly punish the perpetrator, and said, "What angers me is that there's no mechanism for people who are being victimized right now." She also said, "What the state should protect are those who haven't committed crimes." (이날 무소속 한동훈 의원과의 간담회에 나선 김씨는 “(다른 범죄의) 피해자들이 매일 이메일을 보내 ‘도와달라, (수사가) 연계가 안 된다’고 하고 계신다”며 “사법기관이 위태위태하다는 생각을 절로 할 수밖에 없는 상황”이라고 했다. 김씨는 검찰의 보완수사로 가해자를 제대로 처벌할 수 있게 된 자신을 “운 좋은 피해자”라고 표현하며 “지금 이 시점에도 피해를 받는 사람들을 위한 장치가 없다는 게 화가 난다”고 말했다. 또 “국가가 살펴야 할 것은 죄를 짓지 않은 사람들이어야 한다”고 했다.)

At the forum that day, footage of the assailant in the kick assault case being questioned by prosecutors was also shown. As a figure presumed to be a prosecutor's investigator pointed out flaws in the police investigation, one lawmaker said, "That is exactly the process of supplementary investigation in action," adding, "The existing system was that (prosecutors) had to dig out anything suspicious, but now that area has been completely eliminated." (이날 간담회에서는 돌려차기 사건의 가해자가 검찰 조사를 받는 영상도 상영됐다. 검찰 수사관으로 추정되는 인물이 경찰 수사의 허점을 지적하는 모습을 보면서 한 의원은 “저것이 바로 보완수사가 이뤄지는 과정”이라며 “(검찰에서) 뭔가 이상하면 어떻게든 파내야 하는 게 기존 시스템인데, 이제는 그 영역을 완전히 없앤 것”이라고 했다.)

The People Power Party also criticized the move that day, saying, "The passage of the law abolishing supplementary investigative powers is a challenge to judicial justice." Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said at a parliamentary forum that day, "Abolishing supplementary investigative powers will lead to the abolition of the administration," and floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik said, "The police are already lying prostrate like grass before power, and if supplementary investigative powers are also abolished, it won't be democratic control, but a conclusion of 'control by the Democratic Party.'" (국민의힘도 이날 “보완수사권 폐지법 의결은 사법 정의에 대한 도전”이라고 비판했다. 장동혁 대표는 이날 국회 토론회에서 “보완수사권 폐지는 정권 폐지로 이어질 것”이라고 했고, 정점식 원내대표는 “지금도 경찰이 권력 앞에서 풀처럼 눕고 있는데 보완수사권마저 폐지되면 민주적 통제는커녕 ‘민주당의 통제’로 귀결될 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Are They the Same Party?.. Chaos of Lawsuits and Complaints in the Ruling Party's Leadership Primary (같은 당 맞나… 與 당대표 경선, 고소·고발 난무)
item.description:
Are They the Same Party?.. Chaos of Lawsuits and Complaints in the Ruling Party's Leadership Primary (같은 당 맞나… 與 당대표 경선, 고소·고발 난무)

The competition between the pro-Lee and pro-Chung factions over the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea is escalating to the level of a "psychological split." Candidates for party leader and supreme council members, lawmakers, and party members have divided into two camps, hurling criticism at each other, with some even vowing to end the political careers of their opponents. The conflict has also spilled over into lawsuits and criminal complaints. (더불어민주당 당권을 둘러싼 친명·친청계의 경쟁이 ‘심리적 분당’ 수준으로 치닫고 있다. 당대표와 최고위원 후보, 의원, 당원들이 둘로 갈라져 상대를 비난하고, 상대의 정치 생명을 끊어 놓겠다는 말까지 나오고 있다. 갈등은 고소·고발로도 이어졌다.)

On the 4th, party leader candidate Chung Cheong-rae attacked opponent candidate Kim Min-seok over the "Shincheonji intervention in the party convention" allegation, saying, "Are you pushing the party into a death trap and then washing your hands of it?" and "If you can't provide the evidence, apologize first." Chung's camp stated, "We have completed legal action (filing complaints) against media outlets and YouTube channels that spread false information related to specific religions or individuals." This appears to target YouTube channels that raised the Shincheonji intervention allegations. (정청래 당대표 후보는 4일 ‘신천지 전당대회 개입’ 의혹을 제기한 김민석 후보에 대해 “당을 사지(死地)에 몰아넣고 나 몰라라 하느냐”며 “근거를 못 밝힐 거면 사과부터 하라”고 했다. 정 후보 캠프는 “특정 종교·인물과 관련해 허위 사실을 유포한 언론, 유튜브 등에 대해 법적 조치(고소)를 완료했다”고 했다. 신천지 개입 의혹을 제기한 유튜브 채널 등을 겨냥한 것으로 보인다.)

Candidate Kim Min-seok's camp demanded an apology on the same day from pro-Chung supreme council candidate Choi Min-hee. This came after Kim, during the Busan-Ulsan-South Gyeongsang regional primary on the 3rd, said of former South Gyeongsang Governor Kim Kyoung-soo, "He should be given a key role in the government and the party," which Choi allegedly distorted as, "(Kim Min-seok) must think he's president now. He says he'll bring Kim Kyoung-soo into the cabinet." Party members supporting Kim also shared a video from a joint candidate speech on the 1st showing Lee Ji-eun, chair of the party's Mapo Gap district committee in Seoul, poking the cheek of Chung Cheong-rae, who was sitting in front of her, with her finger. In response, Lee said on YouTube, "If (anyone) implies I have a romantic relationship with candidate Chung, I will file a lawsuit." (김민석 후보 캠프는 이날 친청계인 최민희 최고위원 후보에게 사과를 요구했다. 김 후보가 지난 3일 부산·울산·경남 순회 경선에서 김경수 전 경남지사에 대해 “정부·당에서 중책을 맡도록 해야 한다”고 말했는데 최 후보가 이를 “(김민석이) 대통령 됐나 봐. 김경수를 내각에 들여보낸다고 (한다)”라고 왜곡했다는 것이다. 김 후보를 지지하는 당원들은 지난 1일 후보 합동 연설회에서 이지은 민주당 서울 마포갑 지역위원장이 앞자리에 앉은 정청래 후보의 볼을 손가락으로 찌르는 영상을 공유하기도 했다. 이에 대해 이 위원장은 유튜브에서 “정 후보와 남녀 관계가 있는 것처럼 (언급) 하면 고소하겠다”고 했다.)

Both the Chung and Kim camps have also filed reports with the party's election management committee, claiming the other side's campaign activities violated party rules. Chung's camp claimed that pro-Lee lawmakers hung banners with slogans related to Kim in their constituencies, while Kim's camp claimed that the pro-Chung faction instructed party members to "vote spread across different birth months" to get all three of its supreme council candidates elected. (정·김 후보 측은 상대방의 선거 운동이 당규 위반이라며 당 선거관리위원회에 신고하기도 했다. 정 후보 측은 친명 의원들이 지역구에 김 후보와 관련된 구호를 현수막으로 걸었다고 주장했고, 김 후보 측은 친청계가 최고위원 후보 3명을 모두 당선시키기 위해 당원들에게 ‘생일별로 분산 투표하라’는 지침을 내렸다고 주장했다.)

Both Chung and Kim have already stated they would discipline each other. The day before, Chung said, "If I become party leader, I will order an inspection of candidate Kim, and if the findings show there's no basis (for the Shincheonji allegation), I will immediately refer him to the ethics tribunal for disciplinary action." Kim said, "I will refer all those who engaged in wrongful factional activities for disciplinary action." (정·김 후보는 이미 상대방을 징계하겠다고 밝힌 상태다. 정 후보는 전날 “당대표가 되면 김 후보 감찰을 지시하고, 감찰 결과 (신천지 의혹 제기에) 근거가 없다면 윤리심판원에 곧바로 제소해 징계하겠다”고 했다. 김 후보는 “잘못된 계파 행위를 한 사람은 모조리 제소하겠다”고 했다.)

Supreme council candidates clashed during a TV debate held on the 3rd. Pro-Lee candidate Kim Yong accused pro-Chung candidate Han Min-soo of falsely claiming that he personally applied pressure to stop the bleeding from President Lee Jae-myung's wounds during the knife attack on Lee in Busan's Gadeokdo in 2024, and demanded Han's withdrawal from the race. Pro-Chung candidate Lee Sung-yoon raised the issue of party leader candidate Kim Min-seok's absence from the vote to lift the December 3 martial law, and then said he was called "prosecutor-like" by the pro-Lee faction, calling it "an insult to his dignity." Pro-Lee candidate Kim Young-ho demanded an apology from Choi Min-hee for describing him as a bat. (최고위원 후보들은 지난 3일 열린 TV 토론회에서 충돌했다. 친명인 김용 최고위원 후보는 친청계로 분류되는 한민수 후보가 2024년 이재명 대통령의 부산 가덕도 흉기 피습 때 이 대통령 상처를 직접 지혈한 것처럼 거짓말을 했다고 주장하며 한 후보의 사퇴를 요구했다. 친청 이성윤 후보는 김민석 당대표 후보가 12·3 계엄 해제 표결에 불참한 것을 문제 삼았다가 친명계로부터 “검사스럽다”는 말을 들었다며 “인격 모독”이라고 했다. 친명 김영호 후보는 최민희 후보가 자신을 박쥐로 표현했다며 사과를 요구했다.)

Concerns have also emerged within the party over the convention, which centers on nomination rights for the 2028 general election, becoming excessively heated. Lawmaker Park Ji-won wrote on Facebook, "If the party convention goes on like this, the party will be ruined." (2028년 총선 공천권을 두고 치러지는 전당대회가 지나치게 과열되자 당에서도 우려가 나왔다. 박지원 의원은 페이스북에 “전당대회가 이렇게 나가면 망한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "President Lee drops tax bomb on the people the moment he sells his home through a loophole" (장동혁 “李대통령, 꼼수로 집 팔자마자 국민에게 세금 폭탄”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk: "President Lee drops tax bomb on the people the moment he sells his home through a loophole" (장동혁 “李대통령, 꼼수로 집 팔자마자 국민에게 세금 폭탄”)

The People Power Party on the 4th criticized the government's real estate tax reform plan, saying, "They have dropped a tax bomb without presenting a single supply measure." Pointing out that President Lee Jae-myung had pledged during the last presidential election to reduce real estate taxes and increase supply, the party also drew assessments such as "It's going in the exact opposite direction of the promise" and "This is Moon Jae-in season 2." (국민의힘은 4일 정부의 부동산 세제 개편안에 대해 “공급 대책 하나 내놓지 않으면서 세금 폭탄을 투하했다”고 비판했다. 지난 대선 당시 이재명 대통령이 부동산 세금을 줄이고 공급을 늘리겠다고 공약했던 것을 지적하며 “약속과 정반대로 가고 있다” “문재인 시즌 2″라는 평가도 나왔다.)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk held an emergency press conference at the National Assembly that afternoon and said, "The President, who used a loophole to sell his home and become a non-homeowner, has immediately imposed a tax bomb on the people." President Lee recently sold an apartment in Bundang-gu, Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, which he had purchased in 1998 for 366 million won, for 2.9 billion won, after setting up a 1.77 billion won collateral mortgage for a buyer short on funds. Representative Jang said, "The government has dressed this up as normalizing transactions, but in essence it is a punitive tax that punishes people for owning a home." <<> Floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik, referring to President Lee's statement during last year's presidential election that "I will not try to control housing prices through taxes," wrote on Facebook, "President Lee Jae-myung's real estate policy, which has chosen a tax bomb, is racing in the complete opposite direction of his promises." Within the People Power Party that day, a saying about the government's tax reform plan also went viral: "Buy one, and there's the acquisition tax; sell one, and there's the capital gains tax; live in one, and there's the comprehensive real estate tax; own one, and there's the holding tax; rent it out, and there's the gift tax; die, and there's the inheritance tax; don't buy one, and there's the surge in jeonse and monthly rent prices." <<> Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, who has been critical of President Lee's real estate policy, wrote on Facebook that afternoon, "There is a great risk that the 'tax hell' where taxes apply whether you buy or sell will only worsen," and stressed the need for supply-oriented real estate policy. He predicted that even if the government's real estate tax reform plan is implemented, the supply of listings in the ultra-high-end housing market is unlikely to increase significantly, adding, "The biggest victims will not be landlords, but ordinary people and young people who have to find jeonse or monthly rentals." <<> Lawmaker Na Kyung-won said, "The Lee Jae-myung administration and the Democratic Party are determined to repeat the real estate disaster of the Moon Jae-in government, which sought to control housing prices with taxes as a weapon and divided the people into 'haves and have-nots.'" Lawmaker Cho Jung-hun said, "People whose homes have appreciated in value should not be treated as if they are enjoying unearned income." Former lawmaker Yoo Seung-min said, "Just as the cynical saying goes—'He said he wouldn't control housing prices with taxes, and I actually believed him'—the President has now overturned every promise he made to the people." <<> Regarding President Lee's remarks at a cabinet meeting that morning that "even on a capital gain of 10 billion won, the tax would only be a few hundred million won," lawmaker Park Soo-young said, "How many properties actually fall into that category? Using a tiny minority of cases as an excuse, are they trying to shatter the housing ladder of the vast majority of the middle class who have faithfully held on to a single home?" (장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 이날 오후 국회에서 긴급 기자회견을 열고 “대통령이 꼼수로 집을 팔아 무주택자가 되자마자 국민에게 세금 폭탄을 안겼다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 최근 자금이 모자란 매수인을 위해 17억7000만원의 근저당권을 설정해 주고 1998년 3억6600만원에 매입한 경기 성남 분당구의 아파트를 29억원에 팔았다. 장 대표는 “(정부는) 거래 정상화라고 포장했지만 본질은 집 가진 죄를 묻는 징벌세”라고 했다.)

item.title: Despite 60% Public Opposition... Ruling Party Rushes Passage Ahead of Convention, Lee Immediately Approves (국민 60% 반대에도… 전대 앞둔 與 속전속결 처리, 李는 곧바로 의결)
item.description:
Despite 60% Public Opposition... Ruling Party Rushes Passage Ahead of Convention, Lee Immediately Approves (국민 60% 반대에도… 전대 앞둔 與 속전속결 처리, 李는 곧바로 의결)

As President Lee approved the Criminal Procedure Act amendment at a Cabinet meeting on the 4th despite more than half of the public opposing it, without exercising a veto, political circles noted, "He was mindful of the situation where hardcore supporters are strongly demanding the 'complete abolition of prosecutorial investigative powers' ahead of the Democratic Party's convention." In a Gallup Korea survey last month, 61% of respondents said supplementary investigative powers should be maintained. Only 23% said they should be abolished. However, when narrowed to 'Democratic Party supporters,' maintaining supplementary investigative powers stood at 46%, while abolition was 39%, narrowing the gap to 7 percentage points. The opposition said, "In the end, the president demolished a criminal justice system maintained for 72 years, looking only at the Democratic Party's hardcore members, not the people." (이재명 대통령이 4일 국무회의에서 전 국민의 절반 이상이 반대하는 형사소송법 개정안을 거부권 행사 없이 통과시키자, 정치권에서는 “더불어민주당 전당대회를 앞두고 강성 지지층이 ‘검찰 수사권 전면 폐지’를 강하게 요구하는 상황을 의식한 것”이라는 말이 나왔다. 한국갤럽의 지난달 조사에서 보완 수사권을 유지해야 한다는 응답은 전체의 61%였다. 폐지해야 한다는 응답은 23%에 그쳤다. 하지만 ‘민주당 지지층’으로 조사 대상을 좁히면 보완 수사권 유지는 46%, 폐지는 39%로 격차가 7%p(포인트)로 줄었다. 야당은 “결국 대통령이 국민이 아니라 민주당 강성 당원만 보고 72년 유지된 형사 사법 시스템을 허물어버린 것”이라고 했다.)

After taking office, President Lee supported 'prosecutorial reform' centered on separating investigation and indictment, but took the position that prosecutors' supplementary investigative powers should be exceptionally permitted. At a New Year's press conference in January, President Lee said, "There are cases where supplementary investigative powers are exceptionally necessary," citing cases where the statute of limitations is nearly expired. He said the goal was to prevent situations where criminals profit and victims suffer instead. (이 대통령은 취임 뒤 수사·기소 분리를 골자로 한 ‘검찰 개혁’에는 찬성했지만, 검사의 보완 수사권은 예외적으로 허용해야 한다는 입장을 취했다. 지난 1월 신년 기자회견에서 이 대통령은 “보완 수사권이 예외적으로 필요한 경우가 있다”며 공소시효가 얼마 남지 않은 사건을 예로 들었다. 범죄자가 이득을 보고 범죄 피해자가 오히려 손해를 보는 상황은 막자는 것이다.)

However, when hardliners within the ruling party, including former Representative Chung Chung-rae, began insisting on 'abolishing all prosecutorial investigative powers without question,' President Lee changed his stance. At a press conference marking his first anniversary in office in June, President Lee said, "My thinking hasn't changed, but politics is reality," adding, "I'll leave it to the National Assembly." He then blamed the prosecution, saying, "The prosecution has ruined too much. They should see it as karmic retribution." At the Cabinet meeting that day, President Lee also said, "The prosecution created cases out of nothing, conducted biased investigations, investigated unrelated charges, and shook people down—and this is where it led." (하지만 여당 내에서 정청래 전 대표를 비롯한 강경파가 ‘닥치고 검찰 수사권 전부 폐지’를 주장하고 나서자, 이 대통령도 입장을 바꿨다. 이 대통령은 지난 6월 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 “지금도 생각은 변함이 없지만, 정치는 현실”이라며 “국회에 맡기겠다”고 했다. 그러면서 “검찰이 너무 많이 망가뜨렸다. 업보라고 생각해야 한다”며 검찰을 탓했다. 이 대통령은 이날 국무회의에서도 “검찰이 없는 사건 만들고 마음대로 편파 수사, 별건 수사, 먼지 털기 하다가 이렇게 돼 버렸다”고 했다.)

Many analyses suggest the reason for President Lee's change of stance is the Democratic Party convention scheduled for the 17th. With the party leadership election unfolding as a pro-Lee versus pro-Chung contest, he reportedly considered that taking a stance to partially maintain prosecutorial investigative powers would inevitably bolster the pro-Chung camp. A ruling party figure said, "Hardcore Democratic Party supporters view the abolition of prosecutorial investigative powers as both revenge for former President Roh Moo-hyun's death and a paramount task. If President Lee sides with the prosecution, they would feel betrayed more than anyone and cast their votes for candidate Chung Chung-rae." (이 대통령이 입장을 바꾼 건 오는 17일 치러지는 민주당 전당대회 때문이라는 분석이 많다. 당대표 선거가 친명(친이재명) 대 친청(친정청래) 구도로 치러지는 상황에서 검찰 수사권을 일부 유지하자는 입장에 서 있으면 친청 진영에 힘이 실릴 수밖에 없는 상황을 감안했다는 것이다. 한 여권 인사는 “민주당 강성 지지층은 검찰 수사권 폐지를 노무현 전 대통령의 죽음에 대한 복수이자 지상 과제로 여긴다”며 “이 대통령이 검찰 편을 들면 누구보다 이들이 먼저 배신감을 느끼고 정청래 후보 쪽에 표를 던질 것”이라고 했다.)

The opposition said, "President Lee signed a monstrous law that makes victims weep in order to erase his own trial." The amendment newly includes provisions requiring courts to rule for dismissal of prosecution when 'charges were brought through serious illegal investigation' or when 'prosecutorial authority was clearly abused.' The ruling party has been pushing a parliamentary investigation and even a special counsel, claiming the prosecution's investigation and indictment of President Lee were 'fabricated.' The opposition, pointing to President Lee's earlier position that supplementary investigative powers were necessary, said of his decision to forgo a veto that day, "This is an admission that it is the final approval of a sordid deal—swapping the dismissal of charges in the president's own case for the Democratic Party's abolition of supplementary investigative powers." People Power Party floor leader Chung Jin-suk said, "President Lee has sold out public safety to guarantee his own security after leaving office." (야당에서는 “이 대통령이 자신의 재판을 지우기 위해 피해자를 울리는 악법에 서명했다”고 했다. 이번 개정안에는 ‘중대한 위법 수사에 의해 공소가 제기되었을 때’와 ‘현저히 공소권을 남용했을 때’ 법원이 공소 기각 선고를 해야 한다는 조항이 새로 삽입됐다. 여당은 이 대통령에 대한 검찰 수사·기소가 ‘조작’되었다며 국정조사를 강행하고 특검까지 추진하고 있다. 야당은 이 대통령이 과거엔 보완 수사권이 필요하다고 했으면서 이날 거부권을 포기한 것을 두고 “대통령 본인 사건의 공소 기각과 민주당의 보완 수사권 폐지를 맞교환하는, 추악한 거래의 최종 승인임을 자백한 것”이라고 했다. 정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 “이 대통령이 퇴임 후 안전 보장을 위해 국민 안전을 팔아넘겼다”고 했다.)

Legal circles, academia, and civil society are concerned that, as starkly demonstrated in the 'Jang Yoon-ki case'—where he murdered a high school girl in May—the harms of police monopolizing investigative powers will fall entirely on crime victims. President Lee himself said that day, "I have many concerns." Still, he added, "Problems made by people can also be solved by people. If there are problems, we can supplement; if there are shortcomings, we can fill them." Acting Democratic Party leader and floor leader Han Byung-do also said, "We will swiftly launch a task force (TF) to strengthen the rights of the socially vulnerable and victims and prepare follow-up legislation." Lee Chang-hyun, a professor at Hankuk University of Foreign Studies, said, "They should have prepared as thoroughly as possible to avoid problems, but saying 'we'll revise if problems arise' is far too irresponsible. This was never legislation that considered the public or crime victims from the start." (법조계와 학계, 시민사회에서는 지난 5월 여고생을 살해한 ‘장윤기 사건’에서 단적으로 드러났듯이 경찰의 수사권 독점 폐해가 범죄 피해자에게 고스란히 돌아갈 것이라고 우려하고 있다. 이 대통령도 이날 “참 걱정이 많다”고 했다. 그러면서도 “사람이 만든 문제는 또 사람이 다 해결할 수 있다”며 “문제가 있으면 보완하고 부족한 게 있으면 채우면 된다”고 했다. 한병도 민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표도 “사회적 약자와 피해자 권리 강화를 위한 태스크포스(TF)를 신속히 가동해 후속 입법을 마련할 것”이라고 했다. 이창현 한국외대 교수는 “문제가 없게 최대한 빈틈없이 준비했어야 하는데 ‘문제 생기면 개정하겠다’라고 하는 건 너무 무책임하다”며 “애초에 국민이나 범죄 피해자를 고려한 입법이 아니었던 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Abolition of Prosecution's Investigative Powers... Lee Says "Justice Prevails in the End" as Cabinet Approves (검찰 수사권 폐지… 李 “사필귀정” 의결)
item.description:
Abolition of Prosecution's Investigative Powers... Lee Says "Justice Prevails in the End" as Cabinet Approves (검찰 수사권 폐지… 李 “사필귀정” 의결)

A revised Criminal Procedure Act that fully abolishes the prosecution's direct investigative powers was passed at a Cabinet meeting presided over by President Lee Jae-myung at the presidential office on the 4th. The Democratic Party of Korea had pushed the amendment through the National Assembly on the 31st of last month. (검찰의 직접 수사권을 전면 폐지하는 형사소송법(형소법) 개정안이 4일 이재명 대통령이 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 통과됐다. 더불어민주당은 지난달 31일 국회에서 이 개정안을 강행 처리했었다.)

Before the revised Criminal Procedure Act was deliberated and approved, President Lee said in his opening remarks, "Exercising the veto is not simply a matter of differing opinions," adding, "It is difficult to see this bill as being seriously problematic to the point of denying the National Assembly's legislative authority—such as being unconstitutional, unenforceable, violating the national interest, or infringing on the executive branch's exclusive powers." Earlier, the opposition party had called it "one of the worst laws in history" and demanded the president exercise his right to request reconsideration (veto). (형소법 개정안이 심의·의결되기 전, 이 대통령은 모두 발언을 통해 “거부권 행사라고 하는 게 의견이 다르다고 할 수 있는 것은 아니다”라며 “이 법안이 위헌, 집행 불능, 국익 위배, 행정부 고유 권한 침해 등 국회 입법권을 부정할 만큼 심각한 상황이라고 보기는 어렵다”고 말했다. 앞서 야당은 “희대의 악법”이라며 대통령의 재의 요구권(거부권) 행사를 요구했었다.)

The amendment passed at the Cabinet meeting that day removes all legal grounds for prosecutors' direct investigative powers, their direct authority to request arrest warrants, and their supplementary investigative powers over cases referred to them. It also expands the grounds for courts to dismiss indictments to include cases of "serious illegal investigation" or "abuse of prosecutorial discretion." The legal community, academia, and civil society have repeatedly warned that implementing this bill would "cause serious harm to the rights and interests of the socially vulnerable and crime victims." (이날 국무회의를 통과한 개정안은 검사의 직접 수사권, 직접 영장 청구권, 송치된 사건에 대한 보완 수사권의 법적 근거를 모두 삭제하는 내용이다. 법원의 공소기각 사유도 ‘중대한 위법 수사’나 ‘공소권 남용’이 있는 경우까지 확대했다. 법조계와 학계, 시민사회계는 그동안 이 법안이 시행되면 “사회적 약자, 범죄 피해자의 권익에 심각한 피해를 초래할 것”이라고 우려해 왔다.)

However, President Lee stated, "The prosecution has effectively exercised dictatorship by using its investigative authority," calling this "an inevitable measure where justice prevails in the end." He added, "Although I spent many years as a lawyer, I couldn't trust not only the prosecution but also police investigations. If there are shortcomings or errors, I will ensure they are promptly and thoroughly corrected." (그러나 이 대통령은 “검찰이 수사 권한을 이용해 사실상 독재를 해왔다”며 “사필귀정의 필연적 조치”라고 말했다. 다만 이 대통령은 “변호사를 오랜 세월 했지만, 검찰은 물론이고 경찰 수사도 못 믿겠더라”며 “부족하거나 잘못된 부분이 있다면 신속·과감하게 철저히 보완하도록 하겠다”고 했다.)

The opposition party criticized, "Is there anything more irresponsible than abolishing the prosecution's investigative powers, maintained for 72 years, overnight and saying 'if it's wrong, we'll fix it later'?" They also view the expansion of grounds for courts to dismiss indictments as "aimed at eliminating President Lee's trials." <<>> (야당에서는 “72년 동안 유지된 검찰 수사권을 하루아침에 없애면서 ‘잘못됐으면 나중에 고치겠다’고 하는 것만큼 무책임한 말이 있느냐”는 비판이 나왔다. 야당은 법원의 공소 기각 사유 확대도 “이 대통령의 재판을 없애려는 목적”이라고 보고 있다.)

item.title: "Supply, Not Taxes, Should Be Increased"... Even Ruling Party Lawmakers Sigh Over Real Estate (“세금 말고 공급 늘려야”… 與 의원들도 ‘부동산 한숨’)
item.description:
"Supply, Not Taxes, Should Be Increased"... Even Ruling Party Lawmakers Sigh Over Real Estate (“세금 말고 공급 늘려야”… 與 의원들도 ‘부동산 한숨’)

The Democratic Party of Korea leadership on the 4th assessed the government's real estate tax reform plan as "tax normalization for growth and livelihoods." However, ruling party lawmakers with constituencies in the capital area reportedly conveyed their concerns to the presidential office and party leadership, saying "tax hikes without supply measures will neither curb housing prices nor invite only backlash." Amid this, Democratic Party lawmakers from Seoul are scheduled to hold a policy meeting on the 6th to devise real estate supply measures. (더불어민주당 지도부는 정부가 발표한 부동산 세제 개편안에 대해 4일 “성장과 민생을 위한 조세 정상화”라고 평가했다. 하지만 수도권에 지역구를 둔 여당 의원들은 “공급 대책 없는 증세는 집값도 못 잡고 반발만 불러올 것”이라며 청와대와 당 지도부에 우려를 전달한 것으로 전해졌다. 이런 가운데 민주당 서울 의원들은 6일 부동산 공급 대책 마련을 위한 정책 간담회를 열 예정이다.)

The government's real estate tax reform plan announced on the 3rd included lowering the comprehensive real estate tax (wealth tax) deduction for non-resident owners of one home and restricting long-term holding special deductions for capital gains tax. Han Byung-do, the Democratic Party's floor leader, said at a floor meeting that day, "We decided to protect one-home owners who actually reside in their properties while reasonably adjusting benefits overly concentrated on ultra-high-priced homes and non-resident properties," calling it "tax normalization for growth and livelihoods." (지난 3일 정부가 발표한 부동산 세제 개편안에는 비거주 1주택자의 종합부동산세(종부세) 공제액을 낮추고 양도세 장기보유특별공제 혜택을 제한하는 내용 등이 담겼다. 한병도 민주당 원내대표는 이날 원내대책회의에서 “실거주 목적의 1주택자는 보호하고, 초고가 주택과 비거주 주택에 과도하게 집중된 혜택은 합리적으로 조정하기로 했다”며 “성장과 민생을 위한 조세 정상화”라고 했다.)

However, Nam In-soon (Songpa District, Seoul), a Democratic Party lawmaker and Vice Speaker of the National Assembly, wrote on Facebook that day, "The real estate tax reform plan leaves much to be desired. Its impact on the real estate market will not be positive." She added, "Policies led by heavy taxes could trigger side effects such as properties being withheld from the market and a worsening rental crisis." Lawmaker Kim Young-ho (Seodaemun District, Seoul) also said, "We need to persuade the government, and even if tax reform goes through, the ruling party should craft a plan acceptable to the public and then persuade the government again." (하지만 민주당 소속 남인순(서울 송파병) 국회부의장은 이날 페이스북에 “부동산 세제 개편안은 적잖은 아쉬움을 주고 있다. 부동산 시장에 미칠 영향이 긍정적이지 않을 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “무거운 세금을 앞세운 정책이 매물 잠김과 전월세난 등 부작용을 초래할 수 있다”고 했다. 김영호 의원(서울 서대문을)도 “정부를 설득해 세제개편이 되더라도 국민이 수용할 수 있는 안을 여당에서 만들고 정부를 다시 설득해야 한다”고 했다.)

Multiple Democratic Party lawmakers who requested anonymity expressed concerns that "public sentiment will deteriorate if supply measures and detailed exemption rules are not pursued in tandem." A second-term lawmaker from the capital area said, "Among non-resident single-home owners, there are many 'genuine buyers' with unavoidable reasons such as living abroad, being posted to regional areas, or children's education. They should not be indiscriminately treated as speculators and regulated." He added, "Follow-up discussions are needed to finely subdivide the regulatory criteria to embrace them." Concerns were also raised that the government plan, designed to lower prices of ultra-high-priced apartments in Seoul's Gangnam area, could create a balloon effect, driving up prices in the 'Ma-Yong-Seong' (Mapo, Yongsan, Seongdong districts) area. (익명을 요청한 복수의 민주당 의원들은 “공급 대책과 정교한 예외 규정 마련 등이 병행되지 않으면 민심이 악화될 것”이라고 우려했다. 수도권 지역의 한 재선 의원은 “비거주 1주택자 중에서도 해외 체류, 지방 발령, 자녀 교육 등 부득이한 사유가 있는 ‘실수요자’도 많은데 마냥 투기로만 간주하고 규제해서는 안 된다”며 “이들을 포용할 수 있도록 (규제) 기준을 정교하게 세분화하는 후속 논의가 필요하다”고 했다. 이번 정부안이 서울 강남권의 초고가 아파트 가격을 떨어뜨리기 위해 설계돼 있다 보니 ‘마용성(마포·용산·성동구)’ 부동산 가격이 오르는 풍선 효과가 일어날 수 있다고 우려도 나왔다.)

Within the Democratic Party, quite a few believe that President Lee Jae-myung's strong rhetoric on real estate early this year stoked voter anxiety and led to the defeat in the June Seoul mayoral election. They worry this real estate tax reform could cast a shadow as far as the 2028 general election. A Democratic Party lawmaker from Seoul said, "Setting the basic deduction for one-home owners at a publicly assessed value of 1.4 billion won has drawn complaints in the region asking, 'What's the basis for that?'" He added, "Without a clear explanation, the public could perceive it as unilateral taxation." It was also reported that during the party-government consultation on the tax reform plan held on the 30th of last month, ruling party lawmakers expressed views that "the middle class should not be burdened with excessive taxes under measures like the wealth tax hike." (민주당 내에선 올 초 이재명 대통령의 부동산 관련 강성 발언이 유권자의 불안을 자극해 6월 서울시장 선거 패배로 이어졌다고 보는 사람도 적지 않다. 이들은 이번 부동산 세제 개편이 2028년 총선에까지 검은 그림자를 드리울 수 있다고 우려했다. 서울 지역 민주당 의원은 “1주택자 기본공제액을 공시가격 14억원으로 정한 데 대해 지역에서 ‘기준이 뭐냐’는 불만이 있다”며 “명확한 설명이 없으면 국민이 일방적 과세로 받아들일 수 있다”고 했다. 지난달 30일 열린 세제 개편안 당정 협의 때도 여당 의원들 사이에서 “종부세 등 증세 대책에 따라 중산층이 과도한 세부담을 지도록 하면 안 된다”는 의견이 나온 것으로 알려졌다.)

Amid these concerns, a mood that "the government plan could be revised" is also emerging within the ruling party. A Democratic Party lawmaker on the National Assembly's Strategy and Finance Committee said, "The government plan is designed to raise both property taxes and capital gains taxes simultaneously, which could leave actual owners unable to sell or hold onto their properties." He added, "We could consider revising detailed provisions to facilitate transactions." Another committee member from the capital area said, "For now, it's the government's plan, isn't it? We need to review whether to revise it through party and standing committee discussions, as well as bipartisan consultations." (이런 우려 속에 여당 내에서도 “정부안을 수정할 수 있다”는 분위기도 감지된다. 국회 재정경제기획위원회 소속 민주당 의원은 “정부안은 보유세는 물론 양도세도 동시에 인상하는 방향으로 설계돼 실소유자들이 살 수도 팔 수도 없는 상황이 벌어질 수 있다”며 “거래를 활성화할 수 있는 세부 조항 수정을 검토해볼 수 있다”고 했다. 수도권이 지역구인 또 다른 재경위원은 “지금은 정부안이지 않느냐”며 “당과 상임위 차원의 논의는 물론 여야 간 협의를 거쳐 (수정 여부를) 따져봐야 할 것 같다”고 했다.)

Still, some within the ruling party argue that "since it only strengthens tax burdens on ultra-high-priced homes, there will be no major side effects." A senior Democratic Party lawmaker told this publication, "It's regrettable that the strengthened property tax target is limited to homes worth 4 billion won or more. The scope of property tax hikes should be expanded further." The Rebuilding Korea Party and the Progressive Party are also calling for stronger real estate taxation. (다만 여당 내에서 “초고가 주택에 한해 세 부담을 강화하는 것인 만큼 큰 부작용이 없을 것”이란 의견도 나온다. 민주당 한 중진 의원은 본지에 “보유세 강화 대상을 40억원 이상 초고가 주택에 한정한 것이 아쉽다”며 “보유세 강화 범위를 더욱 강화해야 한다”고 했다. 조국혁신당, 진보당 등도 더 강력한 부동산 과세를 주장하고 있다.)

Meanwhile, Democratic Party lawmakers with constituencies in Seoul have decided to hold a policy meeting on the 6th to devise real estate supply measures. They will also form a special committee at the level of the Democratic Party's Seoul city chapter to regularly monitor and respond to housing supply issues within Seoul. A lawmaker from Seoul said, "The government's target for housing supply in Seoul this year is 65,000 units, but the performance through May is far short," adding, "Lawmakers will step in directly to oversee the supply situation." (이런 가운데 서울에 지역구를 둔 민주당 의원들은 오는 6일 부동산 공급 대책 마련을 위한 정책 간담회를 열기로 했다. 민주당 서울시당 차원의 특별위원회도 구성해 서울 내 주택 공급 문제를 수시로 점검·대응하기로 했다. 서울 지역 한 의원은 “정부의 올해 서울 주택 공급 목표가 6만5000호인데 5월까지의 공급 실적이 턱없이 부족한 상황”이라며 “의원들이 직접 나서 공급 상황을 챙길 예정”이라고 했다.)

item.title: "In the Most Dangerous Moments, I Will Lead from the Front and Take Responsibility" (“위험한 순간일수록 가장 앞에서 책임지겠다”)
item.description:
"In the Most Dangerous Moments, I Will Lead from the Front and Take Responsibility" (“위험한 순간일수록 가장 앞에서 책임지겠다”)

Bae Seon-young (46, Class of 57 at the Naval Academy) has been appointed as the commanding officer of the Dokdo-class large transport ship Dokdo (LPH-6111), a 14,500-ton vessel in our Navy. This marks the first time in Navy history that a female officer has taken command of a "Captain-class warship," which forms the backbone of naval power, including Aegis destroyers and state-of-the-art submarines. Naval vessels are classified by the rank of their commanding officer into Captain-class down to Lieutenant-class, with Captain-class ships being assessed as having the greatest size and strategic importance. Commander Bae said on the 4th, "A commanding officer is not someone who sits in the safest spot on the bridge, but someone who leads from the front and takes responsibility in the most dangerous moments," adding, "I will command the Dokdo to ensure it demonstrates perfect combined and joint operational capabilities in times of crisis." (우리 해군의 1만4500t급 대형수송함인 독도함(LPH-6111)의 함장으로 배선영(46·해사 57기) 대령이 임명됐다. 이지스 구축함과 최신예 잠수함 등 해군 전력의 주축이 되는 ‘대령급 함정’의 지휘를 여군이 맡는 것은 해군 역사상 처음이다. 해군 함정은 함장 또는 정장의 계급에 따라 대령급~대위급으로 나뉘며, 대령급은 그중 함정의 규모와 전략적 중요도가 가장 높다고 평가된다. 배 대령은 4일 “지휘관은 함교의 가장 안전한 곳에 앉아있는 사람이 아니라, 위험한 순간일수록 가장 앞에서 책임을 지는 사람이어야 한다”며 “독도함이 유사시 완벽한 연합 합동 작전 능력을 발휘하도록 지휘하겠다”고 말했다.)

Commander Bae entered the Naval Academy in 1999 as part of Class 57, the first year female midshipmen were selected, and was commissioned in 2003. She is a surface warfare expert who has served as commanding officer of Patrol Killer Boat 282, operations officer of the Namwon-class patrol corvette, and commanding officer of the Wonsan-class minelayer. In 2015, she also served aboard the Dokdo as a deck officer controlling on-deck operations, and now, 11 years later, she returns to the Dokdo as its commanding officer. (배 대령은 해군사관학교가 처음 여생도를 선발한 1999년 해사 57기로 입교해 2003년 임관했다. 이후 참수리 282호정 정장, 남원함(초계함) 작전관, 원산함(기뢰부설함) 함장 등을 거친 해상 작전 전문가다. 2015년 독도함에서 갑판 위 현장 작업을 통제하는 갑판사관으로도 근무했는데, 이번에 11년 만에 함장으로 독도함에 다시 오르게 됐다.)

Commander Bae said, "During my time as a deck officer, I was deeply impressed by the commanding officer leading maritime operations, and I harbored a dream of one day sailing the seas as the commander of this massive vessel," adding, "Standing on the bridge of the Dokdo again as its commanding officer is both an infinite honor and a profound responsibility." (배 대령은 “갑판사관으로 근무할 당시, 해양 작전을 주도적으로 지휘하는 함장님의 모습에 깊은 인상을 받았고, 언젠가 이 거대한 함정을 이끄는 지휘관으로서 바다를 누비겠다는 꿈을 품었다”며 “함장으로서 다시 독도함의 함교에 서게 돼 무한한 영광이자 막중한 책임감을 느낀다”고 했다.)

Launched in 2005, the Dokdo is 199 meters long and 30 meters wide, making it the largest vessel in our Navy's inventory. In addition to a crew of about 300, it can carry over 700 landing forces. It can also load various military equipment, including 7 to 12 helicopters, 6 tanks and KAAV amphibious assault vehicles, and 8 five-ton trucks. Alongside the Marado (launched in 2018), it is one of only two large transport ships, and is classified as a "Captain-class vessel" together with the Aegis-equipped Sejong the Great-class and Jeongjo the Great-class destroyers (7,600 to 8,200 tons) and the Dosan Ahn Chang-ho-class submarines (3,000 tons). (2005년 진수된 독도함은 길이 199m, 폭 30m로 우리 해군이 보유한 함정 가운데 가장 크다. 승조원 300여 명 외에 상륙군 700여 명이 탑승할 수 있다. 그 외에 헬기 7~12대, 전차 및 상륙돌격장갑차(KAAV) 6대, 5t 차량 8대 등 다양한 군사 장비를 적재할 수 있다. 마라도함(2018년 진수)과 함께 단 두 대뿐인 대형 수송함으로, 이지스함인 세종대왕급·정조대왕급 구축함(7600~8200t급), 도산안창호급 잠수함(3000t급)과 함께 ‘대령급 함정’으로 분류된다.)

The commanding officer of the Dokdo must direct maritime, air, and amphibious operations while carrying out troop transport missions. Commander Bae said, "The core of my command philosophy is 'sharing joy and sorrow together,'" and added, "I will exercise warm leadership that shares both hardship and glory with my crew." She also stated, "In peacetime, the Dokdo will maintain perfect readiness, going to sea whenever the people call to protect their lives and safety, and in times of crisis, it will be a sharp spear that strikes at the enemy's vulnerabilities and a steadfast shield." (이런 독도함 함장은 해상·공중·상륙 작전을 지휘하고 병력 수송 임무를 수행해야 한다. 배 대령은 “제 지휘 철학의 핵심은 ‘동고동락’”이라며 “승조원들과 고통과 영광을 함께 나누는 따뜻한 리더십을 발휘하겠다”고 했다. 또 “독도함은 평시에는 완벽한 대비태세로 국민이 부르면 언제든 바다로 나가 국민의 생명과 안전을 지키고, 유사시에는 적의 허를 찌르는 예리한 창이자 든든한 방패가 되겠다”고 했다.)

Fourteen years after the Navy produced its first female fast patrol boat commander (Lieutenant) in 2012, the emergence of a Captain-class commanding officer suggests an expanding role for female officers in Navy leadership. In 2017, a Lieutenant Commander-class commanding officer was produced, and in 2020, a Commander-class commanding officer emerged from among female officers. The Navy stated, "Beyond commanding officers, we have expanded female personnel across all domains, including maritime operations helicopter and maritime patrol aircraft pilots, submarine crew members, and deep-sea divers (SSU)." Currently, about 2,800 female officers and non-commissioned officers serve in the Navy. (2012년 우리 해군 최초로 여군 고속정장(대위)이 탄생한 이후 14년 만에 대령급 함장이 나오면서 해군 리더십에 여군의 역할이 확대되고 있다는 평가도 나온다. 2017년에는 소령급 함장, 2020년에는 중령급 함장이 여군에서 배출됐다. 해군은 “함장 외에도 해상 작전헬기 및 해상 초계기 조종사, 잠수함 승조원, 심해잠수사(SSU) 등 전 영역에서 여군 인력을 확대해 왔다”고 했다. 현재 여군 장교와 부사관 2800여 명이 해군에 복무하고 있다.)

Commander Bae is also a "working mom" commanding officer with a son in second grade of elementary school. She said, "Honestly, every day is an intense challenge. My husband and parents took full charge of childcare, and my child has grown up well without fussing. I am always grateful for the sacrifice and help of my family, who filled the void I left." She added, "I am always thankful to my thoughtful son, who says he's proud of his mom in uniform, and to my husband, who never complains even while handling childcare on his own." (배 대령은 초등학교 2학년 아들을 둔 ‘워킹맘’ 함장이기도 하다. 그는 “솔직히 매일매일이 치열한 도전”이라며 “남편과 부모님이 육아를 전담해 주었고 아이도 투정 없이 잘 자라주었다. 저의 빈자리를 채워주시는 가족들의 희생과 도움에 늘 감사할 뿐”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “제복 입은 엄마의 모습을 자랑스럽다고 말해주는 속 깊은 아들과 독박 육아에도 불평 한 번 안 하는 남편에게 항상 감사하고 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding her military career, Commander Bae said, "Rather than being confined to the title of 'first female officer,' I have served with the mindset of doing my best in the tasks given to me each day." She also offered words to her junior female officers: "It is by no means an easy path, but you are already doing exceptionally well, and I hope you continue to walk this road together with pride." (배 대령은 자신의 군 생활에 대해 “‘여군 최초’라는 타이틀에 갇히기보다, 하루하루 주어진 임무에 최선을 다하자는 마음으로 근무해 오고 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 여군 후배들을 향해 “절대 쉽지 않은 길이지만 이미 너무나도 잘해내고 있고, 앞으로도 자부심을 갖고 계속해서 함께 이 길을 걸어가 주길 바란다”고 했다.)

The role of female commanding officers is also gaining importance abroad. In 2021, for the first time in U.S. Navy history, Captain Amy Bauernschmidt took command of the Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN 72). In 2019, in the Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force, Commander Miho Otani was appointed as the first female commanding officer of the Aegis destroyer Myoko, holding the rank of Captain. (해외에서도 ‘여군 함장’의 역할은 중요해지고 있다. 지난 2021년 미 해군 사상 처음으로 에이미 바우언슈미트 대령이 니미츠급 항공모함 USS 에이브러햄 링컨(CVN 72)의 함장으로 취임했다. 2019년엔 일본 해상자위대에서 오타니 미호 1등 해좌(대령급)가 여성으로선 처음으로 이지스 구축함인 묘코함 함장에 임명됐다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: "Organizations Can't Beat Momentum"... On Pro-Lee Additional Voting Push, "A Voting Coup" (정청래 “조직은 바람 못 이겨”...친명계 추가 투표 주장엔 “투표 쿠데타”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae, a candidate in the August 17 Democratic Party of Korea leadership election, characterized this party convention as "a fight between organization and momentum" and said on the 5th that "organizations can never beat momentum." (8·17 더불어민주당 당대표 선거에 출마한 정청래 후보는 이번 전당대회를 “조직이냐 바람이냐의 싸움”이라고 규정하면서 “조직은 절대 바람을 이기지 못한다”고 5일 말했다.)

Speaking on Kim Eo-jun's YouTube channel, Jung said, "It's a clash between the spontaneous drive of people asking, 'Isn't this too much? Did Jung Cheong-rae commit a sin worthy of death?' and an organization that, while the media bombs away, unilaterally fosters an atmosphere that 'Jung Cheong-rae won't make it.'" Having visited Gwangju in South Jeolla Province the previous day, Jung added, "I came back with the firm belief from Gwangju that 'just as Roh Moo-hyun beat Lee In-je in 2002, Jung Cheong-rae's momentum will beat Kim Min-seok's organization.'" (정 후보는 이날 김어준씨 유튜브에서 “‘너무 심한 거 아니야? 정청래가 죽을 죄 지었나?’ 하는 자발적 동력과, 언론이 융단 폭격하면서 일방적으로 ‘정청래는 안 될 것’이라는 분위기를 조장하는 조직이 싸움을 붙은 것”이라면서 이같이 말했다. 전날 전남광주를 찾았던 정 후보는 “광주에서 ’2002년 노무현이 이인제를 이겼듯 정청래의 바람이 김민석의 조직을 이길 것 같다’는 확실한 믿음을 갖고 왔다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, regarding the pro-Lee (pro-Lee Jae-myung) supreme council candidates' claim that the structure in which the vote of party members with voting rights closes before the regional joint speeches should be adjusted—and their push for an additional vote—Jung called it a "voting coup." He said, "No voting system like this exists anywhere in the world. If we do this, we should keep voting until we reach the 100% party-wide vote that candidate Kim Min-seok talks about." He added, "The vote is over, but proposing another voting opportunity is a post-hoc vote." He also said, "The rules can't be changed. If this happens, there will be an uprising." (한편 정 후보는 친명(친이재명)계 최고위원 후보들이 권역별 합동연설회 전 권리당원 투표가 마감되는 구조를 조정해야 한다며 추가 투표를 주장한 데 대해 “투표 쿠데타”라고 했다. 정 후보는 “이렇게 하는 투표는 전세계 어디에도 없다. 그럼 김민석 후보가 말하는 전 당원 100% 투표가 될 때까지 투표해야 한다”면서 “투표가 끝났는데 다시 투표 기회를 주자는 건 사후 투표”라고 했다. 또 “(룰은) 못 바꾼다. 이렇게 되면 폭동이 일어난다”고도 했다.)

Targeting Kim Min-seok's history of leaving the party, Jung said, "There's no limit to the total amount of betrayal. Once you betray, you can betray again," and urged, "Party members, please protect Jung Cheong-rae." (정 후보는 김민석 후보의 탈당 전력을 겨냥해 “배신 총량은 리미트(한계)가 없다. 한 번 배신하면 또 배신할 수 있다”면서 “당원들은 정청래를 지켜달라”고 했다.)

On the possibility of ultimately losing under the preferential voting system, Jung said, "I would of course accept the result." He then appealed to his supporters, "Please make me a comfortable first-place winner with a majority." <<>> (정 후보는 선호투표제 하에서 결과적으로 패배할 경우에 대해선 “당연히 승복한다”고 했다. 그러면서 지지자들을 향해 “나를 과반으로 넉넉하게 1등을 만들어달라”고 했다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil "I Will Pursue Impeachment of Supreme Court Chief Justice Jo Hee-de... Refusing to Appoint Justices Is Dereliction of Duty" (송영길 “조희대 대법원장 탄핵 추진하겠다...대법관 임명 거부는 직무유기”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil, a candidate in the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 party leadership election, said on the 5th, "I will pursue the impeachment of Supreme Court Chief Justice Jo Hee-de, who engages in unconstitutional acts and illegalities." (더불어민주당 8·17 당대표 선거에 출마한 송영길 후보는 “위헌 행위와 불법을 일삼는 조희대 대법원장 탄핵을 추진하겠다”고 5일 밝혔다.)

At a press conference at the National Assembly that day, Candidate Song said, "Unconstitutional judicial power that seeks to lord over the people must surely face judgment," adding these remarks. (송 후보는 이날 국회 기자회견에서 “국민 위에 군림하려는 위헌적 사법 권력은 반드시 심판받아야 한다”면서 이같이 말했다.)

Candidate Song cited three grounds for impeaching Chief Justice Jo: refusal to appoint Supreme Court justices, complicity in martial law, and illegal interference in the presidential election. "Former Supreme Court Justice Noh Tae-ak retired in March. Yet Chief Justice Jo has not recommended a single nominee to this day, six months later," Song said, calling it "unprecedented in constitutional history." Song added, "Under the Constitution, recommendation is not merely a power of the Chief Justice but a duty. Refusing that duty is clear dereliction," and said, "Chief Justice Jo must face the judgment of the law." (송 후보는 조 대법원장 탄핵 사유로 대법관 임명 거부·계엄 동조·불법 대선 개입 등 세 가지를 들었다. 송 후보는 “노태악 전 대법관이 3월 퇴임했다. 그런데 조 대법원장은 반년이 지난 오늘까지 단 한 명도 (임명) 제청하지 않고 있다”면서 “헌정사에 전례가 없는 일”이라고 했다. 송 후보는 “헌법상 제청은 대법원장의 권한이기 이전에 의무다. 의무의 거부는 명백한 직무 유기”라면서 “조 대법원장은 법의 심판을 받아야 한다”고 했다.)

Regarding the December 3 martial law declaration, Song said, "The next day, Chief Justice Jo's first words were, 'We need to see what procedures the martial law went through.' Instead of pointing out the illegality of martial law, he was calculating the judiciary's position after martial law. Silence is complicity." (12·3 비상계엄과 관련해선 “(계엄) 다음 날 조 대법원장의 첫마디는 ‘계엄이 어떤 절차를 거쳤는지 지켜봐야 한다’였다”면서 “계엄의 위법을 지적하는 대신, 계엄 이후의 사법부를 계산하고 있었던 것이다. 침묵은 곧 동조”라고 했다.)

On the Supreme Court's decision to remand President Lee Jae-myung's case for retrial with a guilty finding ahead of last year's presidential election, Song said, "The purpose was singular: to bring down Lee Jae-myung, the leading presidential candidate," calling it "election interference under the guise of justice." (송 후보는 대법원이 지난해 대선을 앞두고 이재명 대통령 사건을 유죄 취지로 파기환송한 데 대해선 “목적은 단 하나였다. 유력 대선 후보 이재명을 낙마시키는 것”이라면서 “사법의 이름을 빌린 선거 개입”이라고 했다.)

Song said, "The essence running through these three matters is the judicial power's violation of the constitutional order." He added, "Along with a competence dispute adjudication over the infringement of the National Assembly's authority and a criminal complaint for dereliction of duty, I will pursue an impeachment motion. I will suspend Jo Hee-de from his duties, complete the composition of constitutional institutions, and restore the constitutional order." (송 후보는 “이 세 가지를 관통하는 본질은 사법 권력의 헌정 질서 유린”이라고 했다. 또 “국회 권한 침해에 대한 권한쟁의심판, 직무 유기 고발과 함께 탄핵소추를 추진하겠다”면서 “조희대의 직무를 정지시키고, 헌법기관 구성을 완성해 헌정 질서를 회복하겠다”라고 했다.)

Candidate Kim Min-seok, also running in the party leadership election, mentioned the impeachment of Chief Justice Jo on the 30th of last month. At the time, Kim wrote on X (formerly Twitter), "Chief Justice Jo Hee-de's dereliction of duty has gone too far," adding, "If he does not immediately recommend a successor, can he avoid impeachment in defense of the constitutional order?" (당대표 선거에 출마한 김민석 후보도 지난달 30일 조 대법원장 탄핵을 언급했다. 당시 김 후보는 X(옛 트위터)에 “조희대 대법원장의 직무 유기가 도를 넘었다”면서 “후임 제청을 즉각 하지 않고 헌정 수호 차원의 탄핵을 피할 수 있겠나”라는 글을 남겼다.)

item.title: Seo Beom-soo Apologizes for Controversial "Roundhouse Kick Match" Remark: "A Slip of the Tongue, Entirely My Fault" (서범수 “돌려차기 한판” 발언 논란에 “실언, 전적으로 저의 잘못” 사과)
item.description:
Seo Beom-soo Apologizes for Controversial "Roundhouse Kick Match" Remark: "A Slip of the Tongue, Entirely My Fault" (서범수 “돌려차기 한판” 발언 논란에 “실언, 전적으로 저의 잘못” 사과)

Seo Beom-soo, a lawmaker from the People Power Party, said on the 4th, "I bow my head in apology to the victim and her family," regarding the controversy that arose when he told fellow party lawmaker Jin Jong-oh, "Let's have a roundhouse kick match," at a meeting attended by the victim of the 'Busan roundhouse kick case.' (서범수 국민의힘 의원은 4일 ‘부산 돌려차기 사건’ 피해자가 참석하는 간담회에서 같은 당 진종오 의원에게 “돌려차기 한판 하지”라고 말해 논란이 발생한 것에 대해 “피해자와 가족들께 머리 숙여 사죄드린다”고 했다.)

Seo attended the meeting titled 'Prohibition of Supplementary Investigation, the Gates of Hell Have Opened,' hosted by independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon that afternoon. It was a gathering where Kim Jin-ju (a pseudonym), the victim of the Busan roundhouse kick case, was present. (서 의원은 이날 오후 무소속 한동훈 의원이 주최한 ‘보완수사 금지, 지옥문이 열렸다’ 간담회에 참석했다. 부산 돌려차기 사건 피해자 김진주(가명)씨가 참석하는 자리였다.)

Before the meeting began, Seo said to Jin, "Let's have a roundhouse kick match." In response, Jin played along, indicating that "I'm better with my hands than my feet." (간담회 시작 전, 서 의원은 진 의원에게 “돌려차기 한판 하지”라고 말했다. 이에 진 의원은 ‘저는 발보다 손을 더 잘 쓴다’는 취지로 맞장구를 쳤다.)

Once the remarks became public, Seo wrote on Facebook, "Before the start of the emergency discussion on the abolition of supplementary investigation rights, I made a slip of the tongue," adding, "It is entirely my fault." Seo also said, "Knowing the wounds that the victim, who endured a difficult time and gathered the courage to attend the discussion, may have suffered upon belatedly hearing this remark, I cannot hold my head up," and "I bow my head in apology to the victim and her family." (해당 발언이 알려지자 서 의원은 페이스북에 “보완수사권 폐지 관련 긴급 토론회 시작 전, 제가 실언을 했다”라며 “전적으로 저의 잘못”이라고 했다. 서 의원은 “힘든 시간을 견디고 용기를 내 토론회에 참석해 주신 피해자분께서 뒤늦게 이 발언을 접하고 받았을 상처를 생각하면 고개를 들 수 없다”라며 “피해자와 가족분들께 머리 숙여 사죄드린다”고 했다.)

Jin also stated on Facebook, "I sincerely apologize to the victim of the roundhouse kick case, the attendees, and the public who were hurt by my inappropriate remarks before the discussion began." Jin added, "I will ensure that something like this never happens again by being more careful with my words and actions in the future." (진 의원도 페이스북에서 “토론회 시작 전 저의 부적절한 발언으로 상처받은 돌려차기 사건 피해자와 참석자 여러분, 그리고 국민 여러분께 진심으로 사죄드린다”고 했다. 진 의원은 “앞으로 더욱 신중한 언행으로 다시는 이런 일이 없도록 하겠다”고 했다.)
